entries.label: P: “Vukašin Despotović is Co-Founder and Head of Business Devel…”
entries.value: Vukašin Despotović is Co-Founder and Head of Business Development at OOX Limited, focused on product–market fit, scalable growth systems, and strategic validation in mobile game development.

entries.label: P: “With a background in Business Economics and advanced resear…”
entries.value: With a background in Business Economics and advanced research in business systems, he approaches growth analytically—treating customer acquisition, retention, and profitability as measurable systems rather than guesswork. His work centers on aligning market opportunity with disciplined execution and long-term sustainability.
